description: Variation of condition 10 related to the submission of an energy and sustainability strategy and replacement of approved strategy with new report of planning permission 00890/C/P25 for erection of an extension to the hotel and car parking, approved on appeal 14.10.2009
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years
from the date of this decision.

Condition : 2 - Only those materials in the following schedule approved under application 00890/C/P25(2,3) shall be used in the construction of the building unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Schedule of Materials and other supporting information/samples:
1. Black Brick Panel- Ibstock Black Onyx 5100
2. White painted brick panel- Smooth brick with white masonry paint
3. Stock brick panel- Ibstock Cooksbridge Yellow Clamp Stock 4512
4. Marshalls Conservation Paver Silver Grey
5. Marshalls Conservation Sett Silver Grey
6. Velfac Series 200 window section (for structural design)
7. Velfac Metallic 01 finish (for external window frame colour)
Received 12/04/12

surrounding hard landscaped surfaces hereby permitted have been
submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.
Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved
details.

Condition : 3 - Water infrastructure shall be constructed in accordance with the schedule of information approved under application 00890/C/P25(2,3) unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Schedule of Materials and other supporting information/samples:
1. Thames Water Potable Water Flow and Pressure Feasibility Investigation.
2. Logger Maps x3
3. Sample Photo Montage.
Received 12/04/12

Condition : 4 - The extension shall not be occupied shall until an assessment to show that the any plant installed conforms to the guidelines, standards and velocities within the Odour Report received 23/07/12 has been submitted to and been approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The extension shall not be occupied shall until an assessment to show that the rating level of any plant & equipment will be in accordance with the Noise Report received 23/07/12 has been submitted to and been approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
 
The assessment must be carried out by a suitably qualified acoustic consultant/engineer and be in accordance with BS4142: 1997-"Method of rating industrial noise affecting mixed residential and industrial areas".

Condition : 6 - Construction shall be in accordance with the Construction Method Statement approved under application 00890/C/P25(4,5,6)  unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Schedule of Materials and other supporting information/samples:
1. Application Letter 
2. Construction Method Statement
Received 04/05/12

Condition : 7 - Before the garden on the roof of the function hall is brought into use, the
parapet wall along the boundary with properties in Thorney Hedge Road
shall be completed to the height shown on the approved drawings and
shall be retained thereafter. No lighting shall be installed in the roof
garden. The roof garden shall be closed to patrons of the hotel from
23.00 hours to 07.00 hours.

Condition : 8 - The landscaping works detailed on Philip Cave Associates drawing
number 305.01 shall be carried out and a plan for their management,
including long term design objectives, management responsibilities and
maintenance schedules shall be submitted to and approved by the local
planning authority before the first occupation of any of the bedrooms in
the extension hereby approved. The landscape management plan shall
be carried out as approved

Condition : 9 - No external lighting shall be installed other than in accordance with
details to be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning
authority before the building is occupied. Development shall be carried
out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 10 - 10A: Prior to occupation, evidence (e.g. photographs, copies of installation 	contracts and as-built 	worksheets prepared under SAP or the National 	Calculation Method) should be submitted to 	`the Local Planning 	Authority and approved in writing to demonstrate that the development 	has been carried out in accordance with the approved details. If the 	development is unable to 	meet the required 25% reduction in CO2 	emissions through the approved energy strategy, then 	any shortfall 	should be made up through the application of further sustainability 	measures 	unless otherwise approved by the Local Planning Authority in writing.
systems, renewable energy and water use and drainage contained in the
planning report, Energy and Sustainability Strategies by MDA consulting
Ltd dated June 2008.

10B: Prior to occupation, detailed evidence (e.g. plans, photographs, copies of 	installation and 	operational contracts and as-built worksheets prepared 	under the National Calculation 	Method) should be submitted to the Local 	Planning Authority and approved in writing to 	demonstrate that the energy 	plant construction has been carried out in accordance with the 	approved details for future proofing the site for connection to the 	forthcoming Decentralised 	Energy Network in the area.

Condition : 11 - No part of the development shall be brought into use until space has
been laid out within the site in accordance with the approved drawings
for 90 additional cars to be parked. The parking spaces provided shall
thereafter be retained available for the use of patrons of the hotel.

Condition : 12 - No part of the development shall be brought into use until space has
been laid out within the site in accordance with the approved drawings
for bicycles to be parked. The spaces so provided shall thereafter be
retained available for their intended purpose.

Condition : 13 - The development hereby permitted shall not be brought into use until the
facilities for the storage and collection of waste and of materials to be
recycled, have been constructed in accordance with the details shown on
approved drawing PLA-204B. The facilities shall thereafter be retained
for their intended purpose. Rubbish and bottle bins shall be stored within
the hotel overnight and only emptied into the waste and recycling
facilities between the hours of 07.00 and 23.00.

Condition : 14 - Notwithstanding the Guest and Staff travel plans dated June 2008,
submitted with the application and the draft Event/Conference Travel
Plan submitted during the appeal, before the extension is brought into
use a travel plan to reduce the dependency of the extended hotel on the
private car shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local
planning authority. The travel plan shall include details of the targets to
be achieved, methods of monitoring and review, appointment of a travel
plan coordinator and a programme of implementation including a car
sharing scheme, personal travel planning, parking management anddissemination of travel information. The development shall be carried
out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 15 - Events such as weddings, parties, dances or any function involving live or
amplified music or amplified speech shall not take place anywhere on the
site, including the existing hotel, except within the new function hall and
sixteen new conference rooms in the extension hereby approved.

Condition : 16 - The use of the meeting/conference rooms and banqueting facility hereby
approved shall be limited to events giving rise to a combined maximum
attendance of 382 people at any one time.

Condition : 17 - The existing external decked areas on the south side of the hotel shall be
closed to patrons between 23.00 hours and 07.00 hours.
